name: Arcane Shield (Warmage Archetype)
body:
Some warmages delve deeply into abjuration magic to protect their allies on the battlefield. These are the arcane shields.

Tenacious Abjurations (Ex)

At 2nd level, an arcane shield gains a +2 bonus to the DCs to counterspell or dispel abjuration spells they cast. This bonus increases by +2 at 9th and 16th levels. This ability replaces focused mind.

Rejuvenating Abjurations (Su)

At 3rd level, an arcane shield gains temporary strength from abjuration spells. Anytime they are the target of an abjuration spell, they gain temporary hit points equal to the spell’s level. These temporary hit points do not stack and they last for 1 hour per warmage level or until they are lost.

As a standard action, the warmage can confer the temporary hit points to another creature with a touch.

At 10th level, this conferring of temporary hit points becomes a swift action. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 3rd level.

Sudden Protections (Su)

Beginning with 7th level, as an immediate action, an arcane shield can expend an abjuration spell to gain a deflection bonus to AC or a resistance bonus to saving throws equal to twice the spell’s level for 1 round. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 7th level.

Spell Shield (Ex)

At 10th level, an arcane shield gains spell resistance equal to 11 + their warmage class level.

If the arcane shield already has spell resistance, use the greater spell resistance of the two. This ability replaces sudden enlarge.

Shield Incarnate (Ex)

At 20th level, an arcane shield has reached the pinnacle of defensive magic. An arcane shield gains one additional cantrip and one additional slot of each other spell level. They must all be used to prepare abjuration spells. Additionally, all abjuration spells are affected as if by Quicken Spell without increasing the spell slot. This ability replaces war incarnate.
